name: Care Gap Observatory
description: Analyze diagnoses, treatment pathways and costs in public medical-charity campaigns.
author: local

store.tagline: See the care gaps inside public medical-fundraising campaigns
store.description:
Care Gap Observatory is a descriptive dashboard over 666 anonymized Pomozi.ba medical-fundraising case records from Bosnia and Herzegovina. It brings diagnoses, treatment destinations, quoted costs and data-quality limits into one place while replacing patient names and source links with stable anonymous case and patient IDs.

Six specialist tabs cover clinical profiles, campaign finances, geography, anonymized record-level exploration with filters and CSV export, and explicit data-quality review. Every figure is campaign-derived evidence, clearly framed as neither a national census nor a policy ranking.
